title: الكناية هاء
description: Rules regarding the recitation of the hāʾ al-kināyah. Hāʾ al-Kināya refers to the attached, single, masculine, third person pronoun (i.e. he/him). The qira'at differ in the recitation of the hāʾ al-kināyah with regards to whether or not it's vowel will be streched (ṣilah) and whether it will be mutaḥarrik or sākin.

no_silah_when_followed_by_sakin.title: No ṣilah when followed by sākin
no_silah_when_followed_by_sakin.description: When the hāʾ al-kināyah is followed by a sākin letter, no ṣilah will be made by any of the qurra. This is the case whether the letter prior to the hāʾ al-kināyah is mutaḥarrik or sākin.
exceptions: In the wordفِيهِۦ مُهَانًا (occuring at 25:69) Imam Hafṣ contrary to his principle recites the hāʾ al-kināyah with ṣilah

examples.verse: examples of ha al-kinayah followed by sukoon
examples of mīm al-jamʿ followed by sukoon

silah_when_preceeded_and_followed_by_vow.title: Ṣilah when preceeded and followed by mutaḥarrik letter
silah_when_preceeded_and_followed_by_vow.description: When the hāʾ al-kināyah is preceeded and followed by a mutaḥarrik letter, all of the qurra will make ṣilah.

examples.verse: examples of ha al-kinayah with silah

silah_when_preceeded_by_sakin_and_follow.title: Ṣilah when preceeded by a sākin and followed by mutaḥarrik letter
silah_when_preceeded_by_sakin_and_follow.description: When the hāʾ al-kināyah is preceeded by a sākin and followed by a mutaḥarrik letter, Imam Ibn Kathīr will make ṣilah.

examples.verse: examples of ha al-kinayah with silah for imam ibn kathir
examples.description: When the hāʾ al-kināyah is preceeded by a sākin and followed by a mutaḥarrik letter, Imam Ibn Kathīr will make ṣilah.
examples.note: Notice in this example from 2:2 the ṣilah has been denoted by the ya ṣaghīra in the masahif for the qira't of Imam Ibn Kathīr, the same word in a Hafṣ mushaf would not denote the ṣilah as it is only Imam Ibn Kathīr that makes ṣilah in this scenario.

yuadih_and_its_companions_sukoon.title: Sukoon on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يُؤَدِّه, نُوَلِّه, نُصْلِه, نُؤْتِه
yuadih_and_its_companions_sukoon.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in these particular words has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Hamza, Abu 'Amr and Shu'bah will recite it with a sukoon.

yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.title: Qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يُؤَدِّه, نُوَلِّه, نُصْلِه, نُؤْتِه
yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in these particular words has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Qalun and Hisham will recite it with qaṣr.
yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.note: Note this is one of two options for Imam Hisham

yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.title: Ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يُؤَدِّه, نُوَلِّه, نُصْلِه, نُؤْتِه
yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in these particular words has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Warsh, Ibn Kathir, Hafs, Ibn Dhakwan, Kisai, and Hisham will recite it with ṣilah.
yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.note: Note this is one of two options for Imam Hisham
